titleEn: The Glory of Kings — Zadok Sets Out Blessing and Curse (ch. 40)
part: ch. 40 — Zadok Sets Out Blessing and Curse
about: Zadok the priest charges David, Solomon's son and the new king of Ethiopia, to hear the word of God. He sets out the curses for disobedience, closely following Deuteronomy 28 (barren fields, hunger, a brazen sky, defeat, plague, loss of wife, house, vineyard and children), then the blessings for obedience, and ends by praising God as lord of death and life. Several disease names and a few rare words are uncertain and marked (?).

sentences.t: ፵ ፡ ኀበ ፡ አዘዞ ፡ ሳዶቅ ፡ ካህን ፡ ለዳዊት ፡ ንጉሥ ።
sentences.l: 40. Where commanded-him Zadok priest to-David king.
sentences.i: Chapter 40: How Zadok the priest gave his charge to David the king.
sentences.n: Chapter heading. ኀበ is the loose 'where/how' of the ch. 38 heading (?). አዘዞ is አዘዘ 'command, charge' (perfect) with 3rd masc. suffix. ሳዶቅ here, ሰዶቅ in the next line: both spellings are Zadok. This David is Solomon's son, who took his grandfather's name in ch. 39.

sentences.t: ወአውሥአ ፡ ሰዶቅ ፡ ካህን ፡ ወይቤሎ ፡ ስማዕ ፡ ዘእነግረከ ፤
sentences.l: And-answered Sadoq priest and-said-to-him: hear what-I-tell-you;
sentences.i: Zadok the priest answered and said to him: 'Hear what I tell you.'
sentences.n: ወአውሥአ 'and he answered' (አውሥአ, causative stem, perfect) and ወይቤሎ 'and he said to him' (ይቤ + ለ + suffix) open direct speech. ስማዕ is the imperative of ሰምዐ 'hear, obey'. ዘእነግረከ: ዘ- 'that which' + 1st sing. imperfect of ነገረ 'tell' + 'you'.

sentences.t: ወለእመ ፡ ገበርከ ፡ ተሐዩ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወለእመሰ ፡ ኢገበርከ ፡ ይቀሥፈከ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወትከውን ፡ ሕጹጸ ፡ እምነ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ ወትትመዋእ ፡ በፀርከ ፡ ወይመይጥ ፡ ገጾ ፡ እምኔከ ፡ ወትከውን ፡ ድንጉፀ ፡ ወሕዙነ ፡ ወሕሙመ ፡ በልብከ ፡ ወንዋምከኒ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ህድአት ፡ ወጥዒና ፤
sentences.l: And-if you-did you-will-live to-God; and-if-indeed not you-did, will-smite-you God, and-you-will-be lacking from all peoples, and-you-will-be-overcome by-your-enemy, and-will-turn his-face from-you, and-you-will-be terrified and-grieved and-sick in-your-heart, and-your-sleep-also without quiet and-health;
sentences.i: If you do it, you will live for God. But if you do not do it, God will strike you; you will be left lacking among all the peoples, you will be beaten by your enemy, and he will turn his face from you. You will be dismayed, grieved and sick in your heart, and your sleep also will be without rest or health.
sentences.n: ለእመ 'if' + perfect (ገበርከ 'you did/do'); ተሐዩ 'you will live' (ሐይወ). ወለእመሰ: the enclitic -ሰ marks the contrast, 'but if'. ይቀሥፈከ 'he will scourge you' (ቀሠፈ, imperfect + object suffix). ሕጹጸ is the accusative of ሕጹጽ 'lacking', read 'left lacking, diminished beside all peoples' (?). ትትመዋእ 'you will be overcome', from ተመዋዐ (?). ድንጉፅ, ሕዙን, ሕሙም are predicate adjectives (accusative -ኧ). ንዋምከኒ: the enclitic -ኒ 'also'. The curses echo Deuteronomy 28:20-25, 65-66 loosely.

sentences.t: ወስማዕ ፡ ቃለ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወግበር ፡ ወኢትትገሐሥ ፡ ኢለየማን ፡ ወኢለፀጋም ፡ እምዘ ፡ ንኤዝዘከ ፡ ዮም ፡ ወኢታምልክ ፡ አማልክተ ፡ ባዕድ ።
sentences.l: And-hear word-of God and-do, and-not turn-aside to-right and-not to-left from-what we-command-you today, and-not worship gods-of strange.
sentences.i: 'Hear the word of God and do it, and do not turn aside to the right or to the left from what we command you today, and do not serve strange gods.'
sentences.n: Three imperatives (ስማዕ, ግበር) and two prohibitions with ኢ- + imperfect (ኢትትገሐሥ 'do not turn aside', ኢታምልክ 'do not worship', causative of ምልከ). ንኤዝዘከ is the 1st plural 'we command you'. The wording follows Deuteronomy 28:14. አማልክተ is the broken plural of አምላክ 'god'; ባዕድ 'strange, foreign'.

sentences.t: ወለእመ ፡ ኢሰማዕከ ፡ ቃለ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ስማዕ ፡ ዘይረክበከ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ መርገም ፤
sentences.l: And-if not you-heard word-of God, hear what will-find-you this all curse;
sentences.i: But if you do not hear the word of God, know what will come upon you: all this curse.
sentences.n: Opens the curse list of Deuteronomy 28:15. ሰማዕከ here 'you heard/obeyed'; the following ስማዕ is again the imperative, 'hear' in the sense 'take note'. ዘይረክበከ 'what will find you' (ረክበ 'find, befall'), with መርገም 'curse' in apposition.

sentences.t: ርጉመ ፡ ትከውን ፡ በሐቅል ፡ ርጉመ ፡ ትከውን ፡ በሀገር ፤
sentences.l: Cursed you-will-be in-field, cursed you-will-be in-city;
sentences.i: You will be cursed in the field, and cursed in the city.
sentences.n: Deuteronomy 28:16. ርጉመ is the accusative of ርጉም 'cursed' (passive participle of ረገመ), predicate of ትከውን 'you will be'. Note the 2nd masc. sing. address, as through the chapter.

sentences.t: ርጉመ ፡ ይከውን ፡ ፍሬምድርከ ፡ ርጉመ ፡ ይከውን ፡ ፍሬ ፡ ከርሥከ ፡ ወዓዕጻደ ፡ ላህምከ ፡ ወመራዕየ ፡ አባግዒከ ፤
sentences.l: Cursed will-be fruit-of-your-land, cursed will-be fruit-of your-belly, and-pen-of your-oxen and-pasture-of your-sheep;
sentences.i: Cursed will be the fruit of your land, cursed the fruit of your womb, the folds of your cattle and the pasture of your sheep.
sentences.n: Construct chains: ፍሬ 'fruit' + ምድርከ; ዓዕጻደ 'enclosure of' + ላህምከ; መራዕየ 'pasture of' + አባግዒከ. The 3rd masc. ይከውን agrees with ፍሬ. ከርሥ is 'belly, womb'. Deuteronomy 28:17-18.

sentences.t: ወይፌኑ ፡ ላዕሌከ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ረኃበ ፡ ወብድብደ ፡ ወይጠፍእ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ዘወደይከ ፡ እዴከ ፡ እስከ ፡ ያጠፍአከ ፡ እስመ ፡ ኢሰማዕከ ፡ ቃሎ ።
sentences.l: And-will-send upon-you God hunger and-confusion (?), and-will-perish all that you-set your-hand until he-destroy-you because not you-heard his-word.
sentences.i: God will send hunger and confusion (?) upon you, and everything you put your hand to will perish, until he destroys you, because you did not hear his word.
sentences.n: ይፌኑ is the imperfect of ፈነወ 'send' with God as subject (the plural-looking spelling is odd; read as 3rd masc. sing. (?)). ብድብድ: sense uncertain; 'confusion, ruin' (?), after Deuteronomy 28:20, which names curse, confusion and rebuke. ዘወደይከ እዴከ 'what you set your hand [to]' echoes Deuteronomy 28:20. እስከ 'until' + subjunctive ያጠፍአከ (አጥፍአ 'destroy').

sentences.t: ወይከውነከ ፡ ሰማይ ፡ በመልዕልተ ፡ ርእስከ ፡ ብርተ ፡ ወምድር ፡ በታሕቴከ ፡ ኀጺነ ፤
sentences.l: And-will-be-to-you heaven above your-head bronze, and-earth beneath-you iron;
sentences.i: The heaven above your head will be bronze to you, and the earth beneath you iron.
sentences.n: Deuteronomy 28:23. ይከውነከ: 'will be to you' (ከውነ + dative suffix). ብርተ 'bronze' and ኀጺነ 'iron' are accusative predicates. በመልዕልተ 'above' and በታሕቴ 'beneath' take suffixes.

sentences.t: ወይሬስዮ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ለዝናመ ፡ ምድርከ ፡ ቆባረ ፡ ወመሬት ፡ ይወርድ ፡ እምሰማይ ፡ ላዕሌከ ፡ እስከ ፡ ይደፍነከ ፡ ወእስከ ፡ ያጠፍአከ ፤
sentences.l: And-will-make-it God for-rain-of your-land dust (?), and-earth will-descend from-heaven upon-you until it-cover-you and-until it-destroy-you;
sentences.i: God will make the rain of your land dust (?), and earth will come down from heaven upon you until it buries you and destroys you.
sentences.n: Deuteronomy 28:24 ('powder and dust'). ይሬስዮ 'he will make it' (ረሰየ, two accusatives: ለዝናመ … ቆባረ). ቆባር is not certain: 'dust, powder' (?). መሬት 'earth, soil'. ይደፍነከ 'it will cover/bury you' (ደፈነ), subjunctive after እስከ.

sentences.t: ወትትቀተል ፡ በቅድመ ፡ ፀርከ ፡ በአሐቲ ፡ ፍናው ፡ ትወፅእ ፡ ኀቤሆሙ ፡ ወበስብዕ ፡ ፍናው ፡ ትነትዕ ፡ እምቅድመ ፡ ገጾሙ ፡ ወትከውን ፡ ዝርወ ፡ ወአብድንቲከኒ ፡ መብልዐ ፡ ለአዕዋፈ ፡ ሰማይ ፡ ወዓልቦ ፡ ዘይቀብረከ ፤
sentences.l: And-you-will-be-killed before your-enemy; by-one way you-will-go-out to-them and-by-seven ways you-will-flee from-before their-faces, and-you-will-be scattering and-your-corpses food for-birds-of heaven, and-there-is-none who-buries-you;
sentences.i: You will be killed before your enemy. By one road you will go out against them, and by seven roads you will flee from their faces. You will be scattered, and your corpses will be food for the birds of the sky, with no one to bury you.
sentences.n: Deuteronomy 28:25-26. ትትቀተል is the passive-reflexive (ተቀትለ) 'you will be killed'. ፍናው 'way, road'. ትነትዕ 'you will flee' (?). ዝርወ 'scattered one, dispersion' (?). አብድንት is the plural of a word for 'corpse' (?); ለአዕዋፈ ሰማይ 'for birds of heaven'. ዓልቦ is አልቦ 'there is not'.

sentences.t: ወይቀሥፈከ ፡ በዐበቅ ፡ በደዌ ፡ ሲሕ ፡ ወበፈፀንት ፡ ወበመቅሠፍተ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ወበዐዊር ፡ ወበድንጋፄ ፡ ልብ ፡ ወታረመስስ ፡ መዐልተ ፡ ከመ ፡ ዕዉር ፡ በውስተ ፡ ጽልመት ፡ ወኢትረክብ ፡ ዘይረድአከ ፡ በግፍዕ ፤
sentences.l: And-will-smite-you with-boil (?), with-disease-of itch (?) and-with-wasting (?) and-with-plague-of Egypt, and-with-blindness and-with-confusion-of heart, and-you-will-grope at-day like blind in-darkness and-not you-will-find one-who-helps-you in-violence;
sentences.i: He will strike you with boils (?), with scab (?) and wasting (?), with the plague of Egypt, with blindness and bewilderment of heart. You will grope at midday like a blind man in the dark and find no one to help you against violence.
sentences.n: Deuteronomy 28:27-29 (the boil of Egypt, scab, itch, madness, blindness, bewilderment; groping at noon). The disease names ዐበቅ, ሲሕ and ፈፀንት are uncertain and glossed only by that passage (?). ወበመቅሠፍተ ግብጽ 'and with the scourge of Egypt'. ታረመስስ is a quadriliteral, 'you will grope' (?). መዐልተ 'day' is an adverbial accusative. ዘይረድአከ 'who helps you' (ረድአ).

sentences.t: ወታወስብ ፡ ብእሲተ ፡ ወየሀይደካሃ ፡ ካልእ ፡ ብእሲ ፤
sentences.l: And-you-will-betroth woman and-will-seize-her-from-you another man;
sentences.i: You will betroth a wife, and another man will take her from you.
sentences.n: Deuteronomy 28:30. ታወስብ 'you will take as wife, betroth' (አውሰበ). የሀይደካሃ: ሀይደ 'seize, carry off' + 2nd masc. + 3rd fem. suffixes, 'will take her away from you'.

sentences.t: ወትነድቅ ፡ ቤተ ፡ ወኢትነብር ፡ ውስቴቱ ፤
sentences.l: And-you-will-build house and-not you-dwell in-it;
sentences.i: You will build a house and not live in it.
sentences.n: Deuteronomy 28:30. ትነድቅ 'you will build' (ነደቀ). ኢትነብር 'you will not dwell'; ውስቴቱ 'in it'. Each clause is its own short unit, a list of futility.

sentences.t: ወትተክል ፡ ወይነ ፡ ወኢትቀሥም ፡ አስካሎ ፤
sentences.l: And-you-will-plant vine and-not you-taste its-cluster (?);
sentences.i: You will plant a vine and not taste its grapes (?).
sentences.n: Deuteronomy 28:30. ወይነ is the accusative of ወይን 'vine, wine'. ኢትቀሥም 'you will not taste' (ቀሠመ). አስካሎ 'its cluster' (አስካል, of grapes (?)).

sentences.t: ወይጠብሑ ፡ ላህመከ ፡ ሥቡሐ ፡ በቅድሜከ ፡ ወኢትበልዕ ፡ እምኔሁ ፤
sentences.l: And-they-will-slaughter your-ox fattened (?) before-you and-not you-eat from-it;
sentences.i: Your ox will be slaughtered before you, fattened (?), and you will not eat of it.
sentences.n: Deuteronomy 28:31. ይጠብሑ is an impersonal 3rd masc. plural 'they will slaughter'. ሥቡሐ is an accusative participle; 'fattened' is a guess, as ሠብሐ also means 'praise' (?). እምኔሁ 'from him/it'.

sentences.t: ወየሀይዱ ፡ አድገከ ፡ ወኢያገብኡ ፡ ለከ ፤
sentences.l: And-they-will-drive-off your-asses and-not they-return to-you;
sentences.i: They will drive off your asses and not give them back to you.
sentences.n: Deuteronomy 28:31. የሀይዱ is 3rd plural of ሀይደ 'seize, drive away'. ኢያገብኡ is the causative of ገብአ 'return', 'restore'.

sentences.t: ወይገብእ ፡ አባግዒከ ፡ ለአግብርት ፡ ወለፀርከ ፡ ወኢትረክብ ፡ ዘይረድአከ ፤
sentences.l: And-will-return your-sheep to-servants and-to-your-enemy, and-not you-find one-who-helps-you;
sentences.i: Your sheep will pass to servants and to your enemy, and you will find no one to help you.
sentences.n: Deuteronomy 28:31 ('given unto thine enemies, and there shall be none to rescue them'). ይገብእ 'it will go back, pass' (ገብአ), singular verb with a plural subject. The two ለ- phrases are the recipients.

sentences.t: ወይገብኡ ፡ ደቂቅከ ፡ ወአዋልዲከ ፡ ለካልእ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ትሬኢ ፡ በአዕይንቲከ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይኰርዕዎሙ ፡ ወአልቦ ፡ ዘትክል ፡ ገቢረ ፤
sentences.l: And-will-be-given your-sons and-your-daughters to-another people, you-see with-your-eyes while they-beat them, and-there-is-not what you-can to-do;
sentences.i: Your sons and daughters will be given to another people, and you will watch with your own eyes while they beat them, and you will be able to do nothing.
sentences.n: Deuteronomy 28:32. ይገብኡ is read as 'will be handed over' (?). ትሬኢ 'you see/will see' (2nd masc. imperfect of ርእየ); እንዘ + imperfect makes a circumstantial clause, 'while they beat' (ኰርዐ 'strike'). ወአልቦ ዘትክል ገቢረ is 'there is not what you can do' (ክህለ + infinitive).

sentences.t: ወይበልዕ ፡ ፀር ፡ እለ ፡ ኢታአምር ፡ እክለ ፡ ምድርከ ፡ ወጻማከ ፡ ወኢትክል ፡ ከሊአ ፡ ወትከውን ፡ ጽዑረ ፡ ወድንጉፀ ፤
sentences.l: And-will-eat enemy whom not you-know produce-of your-land and-your-toil, and-not you-can to-prevent, and-you-will-be oppressed and-terrified;
sentences.i: An enemy you do not know will eat the produce of your land and your labour, and you will not be able to prevent it; you will be oppressed and terrified.
sentences.n: Deuteronomy 28:33. ፀር 'enemy' takes the relative plural እለ although it is singular in form, a collective. እክል 'produce, grain'; ጻማ 'toil'. ከሊአ is the infinitive of ከልአ 'hinder'. ጽዑረ is a participle 'oppressed' (?); ድንጉፀ 'terrified'.

sentences.t: ሶበ ፡ ጸብሐ ፡ ትብል ፡ እፎ ፡ ይመሲ ፡ ወሶበ ፡ መስየ ፡ ትብል ፡ እፎ ፡ ይጸብሕ ፡ እምብዝኀተ ፡ ፍርሀት ፤
sentences.l: When it-dawned you-say how will-it-be-evening, and-when it-was-evening you-say how will-it-dawn, from-abundance-of fear;
sentences.i: When it is morning you will say, 'How will evening come?' and when it is evening you will say, 'How will morning come?', for the greatness of your fear.
sentences.n: Deuteronomy 28:67 ('In the morning thou shalt say, Would God it were even!'). ሶበ + perfect 'when'. ይመሲ and ይጸብሕ are subjunctives 'how may it become evening/morning'. እም- here 'from, because of'; ብዝኀት 'abundance' is construct before ፍርሀት 'fear'.

sentences.t: ለእመ ፡ ኢሰማዕከ ፡ ቃለ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ።
sentences.l: If not you-heard word-of God.
sentences.i: If you do not hear the word of God.
sentences.n: A broken-off clause that closes the curses and echoes the opening ለእመ ኢሰማዕከ. The apodosis ('then all this will come') is understood. It ends with ። rather than ፤.

sentences.t: ወለእመ ፡ ሰሚዐ ፡ ሰማዕከ ፡ ቃለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ስማዕ ፡ ዘይረክበከ ፡ ሠናይ ፡ እምኀበ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፤
sentences.l: And-if hearing you-heard word-of God, hear what will-find-you good from God;
sentences.i: But if you truly hear the word of God, know what good will come to you from God.
sentences.n: ሰሚዐ ሰማዕከ is the infinitive absolute, 'hearing you hear', for emphasis. Opens the blessings, parallel to Deuteronomy 28:1-2. Here the name is spelled እግዚአብሔር, without the ኣ of the rest of the chapter. ሠናይ 'good'.

sentences.t: ወትኴንን ፡ አህጉረ ፡ ፀር ፡ ወትወርስ ፡ ክብረ ፡ ዘለዓለም ፡ እምኀበ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ አምላከ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ዘኵሎ ፡ ይመልክ ፤
sentences.l: And-you-will-rule cities-of enemy and-you-will-inherit glory eternal from God, God-of Israel, who-all he-rules;
sentences.i: You will rule the cities of the enemy and inherit everlasting glory from God, the God of Israel, who rules over all.
sentences.n: ትኴንን 'you will govern' (ኰነነ); ትወርስ 'you will inherit'. ክብረ ዘለዓለም 'glory of eternity' is a construct with ዘ- 'of'; note ክብር 'glory' is the word of the work's title. ዘኵሎ ይመልክ 'who rules everything' (ኵሎ is the object). Echoes Deuteronomy 28:1, 7, 13; the blessings are briefer than the curses.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ ያከብሮ ፡ ለዘ ፡ አክበሮ ፡ ወያፈቅሮ ፡ ለዘ ፡ አፍቀሮ ፤
sentences.l: For he-honours him-who honoured-him and-loves him-who loved-him;
sentences.i: For he honours the one who honoured him, and loves the one who loved him.
sentences.n: ያከብሮ ለዘ አክበሮ: object suffix anticipating the noun with ለ-, 'he honours him, [namely] the one who...'. Cf. 1 Samuel 2:30, 'those who honour me I will honour' and Proverbs 8:17. ያፈቅሮ (አፍቀረ 'love').

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ መላኬ ፡ ሞት ፡ ወሕይወት ፡ ውእቱ ፤
sentences.l: For ruler-of death and-life he;
sentences.i: For he is the ruler of death and life.
sentences.n: መላኬ 'lord, ruler' (Dillmann's መላኪ (?)), in construct with ሞት ወሕይወት; not መልአክ 'angel'. Cf. Deuteronomy 32:39 and 1 Samuel 2:6. ውእቱ is the pronoun 'he' as copula.

sentences.t: ይኤዝዝ ፡ ወይመልክ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ዓለመ ፡ በጥበቡ ፡ ወበክሂሎቱ ፡ ወበመዝራዕቱ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.l: He-commands and-he-rules all world by-his-wisdom and-by-his-power and-by-his-arm.
sentences.i: He commands and rules the whole world by his wisdom, his power and his arm.
sentences.n: ይኤዝዝ (ኤዝዘ/አዘዘ 'command') and ይመልክ 'rule' are imperfects. ዓለመ 'world' (accusative). Each noun carries በ- 'by' and a suffix: ጥበቡ 'his wisdom', ክሂሎቱ 'his power', መዝራዕቱ 'his arm'. The ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ closes the part.
